summary: This bill allows for the use of pulsating light systems in vehicle high-mounted stop lamps by clarifying existing regulations and directing the Secretary of Transportation to establish performance standards for these systems.

scores.thoughts: This bill mandates the Secretary of Transportation to issue new regulations related to pulsating light systems. While this involves some administrative effort and thus minimal government resources, it does not involve significant new spending programs or appropriations. The cost would be negligible in the context of overall government spending.
